rightsAsset.title: Rights
rightsAsset.loadFailed: Could not load this asset's rights.

empty.title: No rights assigned
empty.hint: An asset without rights is not restricted by any licence: it can be published and used wherever its own metadata allows. Assign a rights record to limit where and until when it can be used, or to require watermarked previews.

rightsAsset.restrictedChannels: Restricted - not available to any channel
rightsAsset.restrictedRegions: Restricted - not available in any region
rightsAsset.restrictedHint: The licence and this asset's own "make available for" settings have nothing in common.
rightsAsset.watermarkHint: Only watermarked previews can be shared. The original file, video playback and PDF pages are withheld.

picker.failed: Could not load the rights records.
picker.none: There are no rights records yet.
picker.notInForce: Not in force, so it cannot be used on a published asset.

assignDialog.intro: Choose the rights record that applies to this asset. An asset has one rights record.

removeDialog.title: Remove rights from this asset?
removeDialog.body: "{{name}}" will no longer apply. Without rights the asset is not restricted by a licence: it can be published and used on any channel and in any region its own metadata allows, and its previews are no longer forced to carry a watermark.

check.title: Check availability
check.intro: See whether this asset can be used on a channel and in a region today.
check.contextDatesOnly: No channel or region chosen, so only the licence dates were checked.
check.watermark: Previews are watermarked and the original file is withheld.

publishBlocked.expired: Publishing is blocked: the licence "{{name}}" ended on {{date}}.
publishBlocked.not_yet_valid: Publishing is blocked: the licence "{{name}}" does not start until {{date}}.

stage.title: This asset's licence doesn't currently allow previews
stage.generic: The licence attached to this asset does not currently allow it to be shown.
stage.loadFailed: The preview could not be loaded. If the asset's licence has just changed, reload the page.
stage.videoDraft: Video playback is withheld: this asset's licence requires watermarked previews.
stage.pdfDraft: Only a watermarked first page is previewed: this asset's licence requires watermarked previews.
stage.noPreviewDraft: The file cannot be downloaded: this asset's licence requires watermarked previews.

bulk.title: Assign rights to selected assets
bulk.intro: Choose the rights record to assign.
bulk.replaceHint: Assets that already have a different rights record are skipped unless this is ticked.
bulk.chunked: Rights can be assigned to 500 assets at a time, so these {{count}} assets will be assigned in {{batches}} batches.
bulk.detailsTitle: Why some assets were not changed
